paragraphs.text: Fifth Dawn offers players four preconstructed theme decks, three of which are focused on two-color combinations while one spans all five colors. Each deck highlights distinctive strategies and synergies that reflect the set’s emphasis on artifacts and versatile creature interactions. From the artifact-recycling mechanics of Nuts and Bolts to the high-powered offense and defense of Special Forces , and the aggressive creature and direct-damage synergy of Stampede , these decks provide both new and experienced players with ready-to-play options that showcase the unique themes and mechanics of the Fifth Dawn expansion. The decks also serve as an introduction to key cards and strategies from the Mirrodin block, making them accessible yet strategically rich for casual and competitive play alike.
Nuts and Bolts is a theme deck from Fifth Dawn .
The two rares in this deck are Auriok Windwalker and Salvaging Station .
Special Forces is a theme deck from Fifth Dawn .
The two rares in this deck are Acquire and Plunge into Darkness .
Stampede is a theme deck from Fifth Dawn .
The two rares in this deck are Cosmic Larva and Rite of Passage .
Sunburst is a theme deck from Fifth Dawn .
The two rares in this deck are Joiner Adept and Suncrusher .
